Curiously, it had not taken heat from his body, but lay so cold against his skin it might just have emerged from icy water. He tried to resist them, push them away, yet they came at him relentlessly. Neither can live while the other survives. Ron and Hermione, now talking softly behind him in the tent, could walk away if they wanted to: He could not.
